verdict.rationale: Poly ships its own built-in agent, so letting users plug in external MCP servers is a fair question for this product. However, every MCP item in the pack describes Poly acting as an MCP server that outside assistants connect to: the hosted endpoint at mcp.poly.app, the Claude Code plugin, and the IDE integrations. Nothing shows Poly's agent consuming third-party MCP servers or their tools, and that server-side evidence cannot be credited toward this client-side story.
